documents: Export Declaration Form (EDF in RBI Annex layout)

signing.note: Signed by authorised signatory with company seal.

channels.title: ICICI Bank Corporate Internet Banking (Trade Online)
steps: Log in to ICICI Corporate Internet Banking (CIB).
Go to Trade > Trade Online (activate if first time).
Submit export declaration documents and attach the signed EDF PDF.
Confirm the specific services-EDF workflow with your trade branch.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your ICICI Bank branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, invoice details XLSX, and supporting invoices zip.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: ICICI Bank Branch Trade Desk
steps: Print the signed EDF (RBI Annex) and affix company stamp/seal.
Include the invoice details spreadsheet and invoice copies.
Submit at the Trade Desk or Forex Branch of ICICI Bank before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - ICICI Bank (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
